create_standby_groups: create standby distributed groups for world, dp, ep, and eplb with configurable tensor parallel size
get_standby_dp_group: get the standby data parallel group coordinator for distributed inference
get_standby_ep_group: get the standby expert parallel group coordinator for mixture-of-experts routing
get_standby_eplb_group: get the standby expert parallel load balancing group coordinator
pop_standby_groups: pop and clear all standby groups returning world, dp, ep, eplb coordinators and node count
